storyEnglish: The journey of Aditi and Karan is a beautiful testament to love and partnership. We met during a rainy day at a local coffee shop. Karan spilled coffee on Aditi's sketch, which started a conversation that never really ended. Five years later, we are ready to say 'I do' under the Udaipur sky. Guided by trust and shared dreams, we are taking our next beautiful step together on 15 December 2026 in Udaipur.
